$comment: Contexts branch protection requires on main. This list mirrors the live rule, so it must change in the same change as the rule. Ruleset main-2 (24045474) requires a bare 'test'. That name was correct while the workflow's suite job was a single non-matrix job, and became unproducible at 2026-09-26T21:02:17Z when PR #68 merged the support-range matrix and GitHub began reporting 'test (3.11)'..'test (3.14)'. Nothing failed and no rule was weakened; a routine CI merge invalidated the rule. This branch repairs it in CI rather than in the rule: the suite job is renamed test-matrix and a non-matrix aggregate named 'test' reports the three gates, so the existing rule is satisfied with no protection change. The defect and the repair are DUK-227. tests/test_required_check_contract.py passes under either shape as long as this list matches the workflow.
